policy: Adapters describe host execution surfaces. They never grant credentials, permissions, or production-write authority. Read-only and state-changing actions are declared separately; state-changing actions require explicit approval and are re-verified after execution.

adapters.name: GitHub
adapters.credential_boundary: host-managed GitHub connection; no tokens in task state
adapters.execution_boundary: repository mutations execute only through the connected host adapter

adapters.name: Vercel
adapters.execution_boundary: production promotion requires recorded action approval

adapters.name: Railway
adapters.execution_boundary: deployment and configuration writes require recorded approval

adapters.name: Supabase
adapters.credential_boundary: host-managed Supabase connection; service-role material must never enter task state
adapters.execution_boundary: schema, data, function, and auth writes require explicit action approval

adapters.name: Browser Automation
adapters.credential_boundary: browser credentials remain in isolated host/browser context
adapters.execution_boundary: external account or transactional mutations require explicit approval

adapters.name: Ollama
adapters.credential_boundary: local runtime; model/provider credentials remain host managed
adapters.execution_boundary: model downloads and network exposure require resource/license/security review

adapters.name: MCP Tool Host
adapters.credential_boundary: credentials stay with the MCP host/server boundary
adapters.execution_boundary: risk and authorization are inherited from the concrete downstream tool

adapters.name: Design and UI/UX
adapters.credential_boundary: design-tool accounts and assets remain host managed
adapters.execution_boundary: production design handoff follows target repository approval and verification policy
